Maya K.: Hey payroll team — I just got paid and the mid-cycle retention bonus shows up on my paystub as £2,500 but my bank deposit was in USD and the net is way lower. I’m still on US payroll (NY). Can someone take a look?
Emma-Fin: ugh, sorry Maya. Can you paste the paystub snippet or screenshot? also which pay date/run id? :eyes: 
Maya K.: pay date 2026-03-09, bank deposit received 2026-03-10. Payrun id: PR-20260309-879. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.example/screencaps/maya-bonus-0309.png 
Alex (Payroll): got it. Looking at PR-20260309-879 now. At first pass the run shows bonus line item with currency=GBP and gross=2500.00 GBP, but bank instruction was USD. That caused conversion and extra withholding lines.
Jordan (HR): did Maya’s hire record recently change region? she was onboarding in US but maybe hiring ops flagged APAC for the one-off incentive? 
Maya K.: nope, still US address and W-4 on file. I did submit a manager note to pay a local currency bonus for a contractor in UK last week but that was for someone else — not me. :confused: 
Alex (Payroll): digging deeper — looks like the bonus template we used has a boolean "local_currency=true" that was accidentally selected when creating the bonus award for team. That toggles the vendor to emit GBP pay components. Payroll vendor (Papaya) then ran FX conversion and treated it as a foreign payment subject to 'country-specific tax treatment' which added extra withholding.
PayrollBot: Notice: PR-20260309-879 processed by Papaya Global · status: completed · taxes withheld: US fed + GBP PAYE (detected).
Emma-Fin: oh no — double withholding. That’s taxable/withholding mess. Options I see: 1) reverse the bonus and re-issue in USD (preferred), 2) issue a correcting off-cycle with reimbursement of withheld taxes, or 3) leave as-is and coordinate tax reclaim (messy for employee).
Alex (Payroll): Agreed. We can submit an off-cycle reversal in Papaya and re-run the payment in USD. Need Maya's approval to initiate reversal (because there will be a reversal line on her next payrun and a new off-cycle deposit). Also need sign-off from Finance to cover gross/net timing. 
Maya K.: I approve the reversal and reissue in USD. I don’t want to handle tax reclaim myself. Please proceed.
Jordan (HR): tagging @Finance for sign-off on off-cycle reversal/cash flow: Emma-Fin, can you confirm?
Emma-Fin: confirmed — Finance approves reversal and reissue. Please follow standard off-cycle process and mark as "employee-consent-obtained".
Alex (Payroll): next steps: 1) create Papaya support ticket referencing PR-20260309-879 + request reversal due to template misconfiguration, 2) run off-cycle reversal (expected reverse posting in 2 business days), 3) reissue bonus in USD off-cycle (same gross equivalent using FX at 03/09 rate or use agreed USD gross 3100.00), 4) update bonus template to remove local_currency default and add a guard.
Alex (Payroll): I filed ticket #PG-45221 and scheduled the reversal. Papaya ETA: reversal posted by 2026-03-12 EOD, reissue off-cycle on 2026-03-13 AM. Will also attach corrected paystub and an explanatory note for Maya.
Maya K.: thank you. Will look out for the reversal and final stub. Appreciate the quick response. :pray:
PayrollBot: Update: ticket PG-45221 acknowledged by Papaya Global support · case owner: L. Singh · next update by 2026-03-11 09:00 UTC.
Emma-Fin: reminder to update the SOP: when creating one-off local payments we must confirm employee payroll country != payment currency. Assigning to Alex to patch the template and add a CLI check.
Alex (Payroll): will add a preflight check to payroll-cli: `payroll-cli verify-bonus --employee-id 3421 --currency GBP` that errors if employee.payroll_country != payment.currency. Will push a PR and notify.
Jordan (HR): good. Please DM Maya when everything posts so she can confirm net.
Maya K.: thanks everyone! really relieved.
Emma-Fin: adding note for W-2/1099: since original run incorrectly applied foreign-style withholding we’ll include an accounting memo and ensure the reversal entries are categorized so year-end reporting remains clean. If any residual reclaim is required we’ll handle with Finance.
Alex (Payroll): closing loop — reversal completed and reissue posted on 2026-03-13 10:12 UTC. Maya net corrected and new stub available: https://files.redwood.example/screencaps/maya-bonus-0313.png. Please confirm receipt.
Maya K.: confirmed, paid and stub looks good. thanks again! :tada:
